_note: Expansion 21 P21-01 (owner directive 2026-10-23, VP-01): the civic records, a record only. 'enabled' false builds nothing, adds no save key and changes nothing in the simulation. When true the records OBSERVE today's offices (reeve, guards, sage) and who leaves a person's story, changing nothing they observe. The authority text below describes what a post does today in code; it grants no power and no rule reads it. No election, voting eligibility, tax rate, punishment or office power lives here (they await owner decisions, docs/expansion21/P21_READINESS.md section 5).

authority.reeve: Keeps the manor's business: once an evening collects the tax under TaxPolicy, pays relief, buys tools for the essential trades, orders repairs and public works (which wait for a living reeve) and buys grain for the granary. Serves for life; the office passes by the trades' succession of posts (NPCBrain._reeve_succession).
authority.guard: A guard of the manor's watch, on the day or the night shift: fights bandits seen, recovers loot, patrols posts, confronts and reports crime. Paid from the treasury each evening (NPCBrain.pay_guards); the post opens only while the treasury can afford one more.
authority.sage: The village's apothecary and healer: brews poultices and tonics and is paid from the treasury each evening. Holds no governing power.

settlement_authority: A named government of an off-map settlement (settlements.json 'government'). Its officials stay the off-map simulation's own (OffMapSettlement.gov); this record names the jurisdiction only.
